title: ui(list): a stored view `sort` the platform's sortability projection refuses is still sent to the server on fetch (ListView L3186), so the list 400s instead of dropping it; client-side sorting still offers a `sortable: false` header
body:
domain:server#6 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzibcN9oHa8kDbTTnL5

Filing gate: this is a seat finding from the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review of PR #30021 (#29896), record 6624674350 ③. That review overturned the PR's "no `domain:ui` card" conclusion. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade.
Business reason: after #30021 the Data API refuses a sort that names a `sortable: false` field. In `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`, `currentSort` is seeded from `schema.sort` (L1971) and mapped into the request unfiltered (L3186). `filterPlatformSortableSort` is applied only to the header display (`ObjectGrid` `manualSort`) and to the emit/persist path. So a list whose stored sort the projection refuses fails its first fetch instead of dropping the refused entry. Separately, under client-side sorting (`manualSortingOn` off), the explicit-column path (`objectGridGenerateColumns.tsx:555`, `sortable: col.sortable !== false`) still offers the header.
Reader who acts: `domain:ui`, `ui/packages/plugin-list` and `ui/packages/plugin-grid`, after #30021 merges.
Dedupe (open and closed): `filterPlatformSortableSort`, `sortable stored sort ListView fetch`, `sortable false view sort`. **New.**

## What to do
- Filter the fetch-side sort through the same projection reader that the header uses, and say so (a dropped-sort notice, if the list already has one for refused entries). The #6455 comment now describes the opposite behaviour, so revise it.
- Decide, against the existing doctrine, whether client-side sorting should honour `sortable: false` on the header.
- Live check on a dev boot: a view whose `sort` names a `sortable: false` field loads with no 400.

Done when no stored view sort that the projection refuses reaches the server, and the header behaviour is ruled and pinned.
